thread:
Aisha (Partnerships): FYI — vendor Jordan says their PO got rejected by marketplace because Legal flagged an 'antitrust kicker' in the master services agreement. procurement is holding payment. Can legal confirm what's required to unblock?
Tom (Legal): Saw the clause. It's a narrow non-compete style paragraph referencing channel restrictions. Flagged because marketplaces want broader distribution rights.
Ravi (Finance): Procurement won't sign with that language. It creates audit risk and could break resale rules. Need a one-line acceptable alternative from Legal.
Aisha (Partnerships): Jordan, can you paste the exact clause? even a short snippet helps. @Tom any precedent language we can use?
Jordan (Vendor): here — "Vendor agrees not to sell or distribute the Service through competing resellers or platforms which materially compete with Vendor's established channel partners."
Marta (Ops): That's definitely a red flag for marketplace distribution. Marketplace requires non-exclusionary language.
Tom (Legal): Proposed replacement (toy example): ``Vendor agrees not to engage in exclusive or materially restrictive distribution practices that would prevent Customer or its marketplace partners from offering or reselling the Service.`` Less prescriptive, keeps core protection.
Ravi (Finance): This looks okay but procurement needs explicit confirmation that this won't trigger marketplace delisting. Can Partnerships check with marketplace ops?
Aisha (Partnerships): I'll ping Marketplace Integration team and Vendor Manager. @Jordan can you accept the replacement or give counter-language?
Jordan (Vendor): We can accept non-exclusive wording, but need an assurance the marketplace won't auto-reject due to previous vendor policy flags. Any contacts there?
Aisha (Partnerships): cc @Marta — Marta, can you escalate to marketplace-ops for a quick whitelist/exception or review? ideally same-day.
Marta (Ops): On it. I'll open a ticket and ping the marketplace steward. ticket id: MP-8742. ETA 6 hours.
ProcureBot: PO 2023-745 pending signature — hold reason: contract redline flagged by Legal.
Tom (Legal): If marketplace confirms, we'll add a one-sentence carve to MSA and sign. Jordan — please sign ack to the proposed text in thread so Procurement can move.
Jordan (Vendor): Ack — will sign the proposed text. thanks for fast turnaround. :thumbsup:
Ravi (Finance): Great. Once MP-8742 confirms, procurement will release PO. Please update PO metadata with ticket id so we have audit trail.
Aisha (Partnerships): Will do. I'll update the PO description with MP-8742 and ping when done. Thanks all.
Marta (Ops): MP-8742 responded — marketplace ops says replacement text acceptable, no delist. Closing loop in 10m.
Aisha (Partnerships): PO cleared, procurement queued signature. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
